timeline.title: Complaint Registered

complaints.title: High-speed Wi-Fi dropping frequently in Central Library 2nd floor reading hall
complaints.description: The Wi-Fi network (Campus_Student_5G) keeps disconnecting every 5-10 minutes. More than 40 students studying for upcoming midterm exams in the 2nd floor quiet hall are unable to access IEEE papers and online lecture videos.
complaints.adminResponse: Campus Network & IT cell dispatched senior technician. The primary access point (AP-204) had an overheating switch port. Replacement Gigabit AP is being wired today.

timeline.title: Complaint Registered
timeline.description: Complaint submitted by Rahul Sharma via Student Portal.

timeline.title: Assigned to IT Infrastructure
timeline.description: Grievance cell reviewed urgency and assigned ticket to Campus Network Admin.

timeline.title: Field Inspection in Progress
timeline.description: Technician on-site at Library 2nd floor. Replacement unit approved.

complaints.title: Digital projector lamp flickering and audio crackling in Seminar Hall 1
complaints.description: The overhead HDMI projector lamp cuts to black periodically for 5 seconds during lectures. Also the left ceiling speaker produces loud static humming during faculty presentations.
complaints.location: Main Academic Block, Seminar Hall 1 (Ground Floor)
complaints.adminResponse: AV Maintenance team replaced the 4K projector lamp module with an OEM spare and re-grounded the PA audio amplifier cable. Successfully tested.

timeline.title: Complaint Logged
timeline.description: Complaint filed regarding Seminar Hall 1 equipment.

timeline.title: Reviewed by Estate Officer
timeline.description: AV team contacted for spare replacement.

timeline.title: Work Order Dispatched
timeline.description: Technician assigned for evening maintenance window.

timeline.title: Issue Resolved & Tested
timeline.description: Lamp replaced and acoustic interference resolved.

feedback.comment: Fixed right in time for our guest lecture! Excellent response and clear audio now.

complaints.title: Water cooler purification filter replacement needed on 3rd floor
complaints.description: The RO UV filter on the water dispensing station shows a red warning indicator light, and water tastes metallic. Students on the entire 3rd floor are relying on this cooler.
complaints.adminResponse: Sanitation officer has tagged the machine and notified the authorized annual maintenance vendor for immediate filter cartridge swap.

timeline.title: Issue Submitted
timeline.description: Drinking water filter warning reported.

timeline.title: Vendor Notification Issued
timeline.description: Water quality team dispatched warning label and contacted service vendor.

complaints.title: Broken glassware and uncalibrated digital scale in Chemistry Lab 2
complaints.description: Precision balance table 4 is drifting by +/- 0.4g which causes errors in titration experiments. Additionally, broken beaker shards near sink 2 pose a minor safety hazard.

timeline.title: Complaint Registered
timeline.description: Safety and calibration complaint logged for Chemistry Lab 2.

complaints.title: Route 12 college bus arriving 25-30 minutes late during morning pickup
complaints.description: Bus #12 from Green Valley / North Ring Road has been delayed continuously for four days this week, causing over 35 students to miss the 8:30 AM first hour attendance.
complaints.adminResponse: Transport coordinator investigated. Road widening construction on Ring Road caused the bottleneck. Revised departure timetable will be rolled out starting Monday with a standby feeder bus.

timeline.title: Transport Delay Reported
timeline.description: Multiple students impacted by morning route delay.

timeline.title: Route Audit Initiated
timeline.description: GPS telemetry logs verified with bus fleet operator.

timeline.title: Alternate Route Deployed
timeline.description: Feeder bus scheduled and driver instructed on shortcut diversion.

complaints.title: Hostel Block C - Hot water solar geyser tripping main breaker
complaints.description: The 1st floor bathroom circuit breaker trips every time the auxiliary water heater is switched on before 7:00 AM, leaving residents without hot water during cold mornings.
complaints.location: Boys Hostel Block C, 1st Floor Common Washroom
complaints.adminResponse: Hostel warden and campus electrician replaced the overloaded 16A breaker with an industrial grade 32A RCCB unit and insulated heating coil terminals.

timeline.title: Complaint Logged
timeline.description: Electrical tripping reported in Block C.

timeline.title: Electrician Assigned
timeline.description: Diagnostics revealed heater coil leakage current.

timeline.title: Breaker & Coil Replaced
timeline.description: Full load test successful. System operating normally.

feedback.comment: Hot water is consistent now. Thanks for addressing this so fast.

complaints.title: Student Canteen Counter 2 digital payment QR terminal offline
complaints.description: The UPI payment display at lunch counter 2 has been showing "Connection Timed Out" which causes huge queues during the 1:00 PM rush hour.
complaints.location: Campus Hub, Central Food Court Counter 2
complaints.adminResponse: IT department provided a dedicated dual-band 4G backup router to the food court and upgraded payment terminal firmware.

timeline.title: Payment Issue Reported
timeline.description: POS terminal failure noted.

timeline.title: Connectivity Restored
timeline.description: New POS soundbox and stable router placed.

feedback.comment: Lunch line moves much faster now! Great job.
